From a documented contract to a project

Take the next step
in your own repository.

Export a reviewed starter, your project brief and a source-linked Codex prompt. The export uses templates locally; it does not call a model or generate a finished custom application.

2–50 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
Included in every export

Runnable source, tests, AGENTS.md, a project brief, official source links, an environment example and release instructions.

Repository contents

Before a public release
The Responses starter runs locally and requires your server-side API key and an available model. Complete authentication, distributed quotas, deployment configuration and live integration testing before exposing it publicly.
The static Codex starter runs without an API key. Codex can extend it using your brief.
